deleteAccount.title: Tirtir akoonkaaga
deleteAccount.intro: Tirtirka akoonkaagu waa mid joogto ah. Meel walba waad ka bixi doontaa mana geli kartid isla akoonkaas mar kale.
deleteAccount.removed1: Magacaaga, iimaylkaaga, taleefankaaga iyo sawirka borofayladaada
deleteAccount.removed2: Bixiyeyaasha aad kaydsatay, xiriirrada aad furtay iyo taariikhda raadinta
deleteAccount.removed3: Bixiyeyaasha adeegga: borofayalka ganacsigaaga, liisaska iyo sawirrada
deleteAccount.kept: Diiwaannada lacag-bixinta, dalabaadka iyo tigidhada oo dadka kale iyo xisaabaadkeenu ku tiirsan yihiin. Way sii jiraan, laakiin magacaaga iyo faahfaahintaada xiriir la'aan.
deleteAccount.signInTitle: Gal si aad akoonkaaga u tirtirto
deleteAccount.signInText: Amnigaaga darteed marka hore waa inaad gashaa. Kadibna boggan wuxuu kuu ogolaanayaa inaad akoonkaaga tirtirto wax ka yar hal daqiiqo.
deleteAccount.confirmLabel: Qor DELETE si aad u xaqiijiso
deleteAccount.delete: Si joogto ah u tirtir akoonkayga
deleteAccount.doneText: Waad ku mahadsan tahay isticmaalka Gabla. Waad ka baxday faahfaahintaada shakhsiyeedna waa laga saaray.
deleteAccount.errConfirm: Qor DELETE si aad u xaqiijiso.
deleteAccount.errPassword: Erayga sirta ahi sax ma aha.
deleteAccount.errFailed: Hadda akoonkaaga ma tirtiri karno. Fadlan mar kale isku day.
deleteAccount.errSupport: Nooca akoonkan waxaa tirtira kooxdayada. Fadlan la xiriir taageerada si loo tirtiro.
deleteAccount.errBlockedRide: Safar ayaa kuu socda. Marka hore dhammee ama ka noqo.
deleteAccount.errBlockedTickets: Waxaad haysataa tigidhada baska ee safarro soo socda. Marka hore jooji ama safar.
deleteAccount.errBlockedOrders: Waxaad haysataa dalabyo aan wali gaarin. Sug inay dhammaystirmaan ama jooji.
deleteAccount.errBlockedBookings: Waxaad haysataa ballanno adeeg oo weli furan. Jooji ama sug inay dhammaadaan.
deleteAccount.errBlockedBalance: Marka hore ka bax haraagaaga jeebka ka hor intaadan akoonka tirtirin.
deleteAccount.errBlockedPayout: Waxaad haysataa codsi bixitaan oo weli socda.
deleteAccount.errBlockedCustomerOrders: Waxaad haysataa dalabyada macaamiisha oo aan weli dhammaystirnayn.
deleteAccount.errBlockedCustomerBookings: Waxaad haysataa ballannada macaamiisha oo weli furan.
